**Thiamine (vitamin B1)** is  [Highlight start] used in people who drink heavily or have alcohol use disorder to prevent and treat thiamine deficiency and serious neurological damage, including **Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome** [Highlight end].[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXyf7hM1DRM6efr9Iqp9ewgQOAxwy-yqmDdrS_XdKXO56-XU1zPwOGFIqIAw0EJrO8seCmuLXUJdLTk8YgN1_Wl1QalBKyK_hoIHsVcOZz1gEaPrlGIvIWIthyRdv4Q2kYEaweTSPysQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1gEBxCJF10W3x49vxa_KBViM5EgSh416pmjTT0QN6u000Z9SWH7fMlLN2MBGUsFZ_wHaccPaEcEaotgV2LeLdbfRcGilpTuyuIARtYs4KR3vmO-0A-FB75yOpL4YxptjIwKc_YtUFpGO-23cEBfwqxRK1kd3wSgbQ3DU1Dh_X1Y6Ol3miZX9X4XjeskaeQoPvAv3Lj1_Zt6BoRPHoaAKJAjqnNFrfwRzaEIMzhMjictLjvNCa6qWHUEERBG5PxKSGilPISznX56R7e1FkLln0YZgqHBZH5Ra)

### Why Alcohol Causes Thiamine Deficiency

- **Reduced absorption:** Alcohol irritates the digestive tract and interferes with how the gut absorbs thiamine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)
- **Poor nutrition:** Heavy drinking often replaces balanced meals, lowering dietary thiamine intake.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)
- **Impaired use and limited storage:** The body stores very little thiamine, and heavy alcohol use impairs how cells use and metabolize it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZYLy5YYNuT7H0gdUTuUa-A3OV-v5B20XhVZtbtvrw-p9W3i30pM1dlKwJ8ZR8Sr6A8fEwGX2K6iMOhWIBSWjNuhlcZXkV1RHTT81b1AVPA3ZLsPxciMNYSzCc4udLR4U_alXgnSUvQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXXPPncN1dfnGFVnVgSvo1gnLpQ7_lCNo-WgkgxPa-WanCRu0jUZ_QPGdPCQ1mL0KtXS6OwomXa454CbVERl4KReCYx36OQpFhPjlY3V5qYC5yjHaZHskshEd6ZK8kFlY-)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)

### Risks of Low Thiamine

- **Early signs:** Fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, irritability, muscle weakness, or tingling in the hands and feet.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF18dmr40rfI21YvnoCqEZ2XdU-NgQI7y38HBS29TEvpG22GGlRr8MqUBDolufnW-mdABFvfSrUHYZglg9lY6V-SCFbcTwo4B9eGvaWic3lP6bg8xxSMtRd1ly48DA1qQfXwWwwo7duYaLq733mDM0Q7sXMLCWrnJ58SheTash0oW9lUpQz0j1lw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)
- **Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome:** A serious brain disorder starting with **Wernicke encephalopathy** (confusion, vision changes, and loss of muscle coordination/balance), which can progress to **Korsakoff syndrome** (severe memory problems) if untreated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)
- **Beriberi:** A deficiency condition that can affect the nervous system and heart.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXyf7hM1DRM6efr9Iqp9ewgQOAxwy-yqmDdrS_XdKXO56-XU1zPwOGFIqIAw0EJrO8seCmuLXUJdLTk8YgN1_Wl1QalBKyK_hoIHsVcOZz1gEaPrlGIvIWIthyRdv4Q2kYEaweTSPysQ)

### How Thiamine Is Used

- **Prevention and withdrawal:** Doctors often prescribe oral thiamine for people with alcohol dependence or poor nutrition, and may give higher doses or intravenous (IV) / intramuscular (IM) thiamine during alcohol withdrawal or hospitalization when malabsorption or severe symptoms are a concern.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1zipmZOAnG-7gFYwLmwxcZh0XjF9XWl81lj6sZk546pxA1Tz0T1-29Ap3MxZbbNUg1Qt6MpwnvJjanFgFBEV7On8kWD8RtHDaMhQR3LvntKJi5LcziyHQ1xrspt1CrlVXacrj7qEp8YvgvdgNVDKiGZWz92_lGRKMmhHMpAyZRaEMweEg78nEG75gtGDB-ODSgkEN1PHMBmeIY0Z)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXyf7hM1DRM6efr9Iqp9ewgQOAxwy-yqmDdrS_XdKXO56-XU1zPwOGFIqIAw0EJrO8seCmuLXUJdLTk8YgN1_Wl1QalBKyK_hoIHsVcOZz1gEaPrlGIvIWIthyRdv4Q2kYEaweTSPysQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHEIkXXH47hlFI6od9T2Mr5kMS1_DP5n9c3c3H4SdybvzCMp8817YdNfE8txh3w2uiThP5VhECx1VapYZa6hEGgrS3LHQlJ1TieFnSP43Rsqr0WjB8-OdN7FZD-bTB8)
- **Limits of supplements alone:** Continuing heavy alcohol use blocks absorption and reduces how well supplements work. Medical evaluation is important—especially if confusion, balance trouble, or vision changes occur—and alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous without medical supervision.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXwHEIkXXH47hlFI6od9T2Mr5kMS1_DP5n9c3c3H4SdybvzCMp8817YdNfE8txh3w2uiThP5VhECx1VapYZa6hEGgrS3LHQlJ1TieFnSP43Rsqr0WjB8-OdN7FZD-bTB8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1gEBxCJF10W3x49vxa_KBViM5EgSh416pmjTT0QN6u000Z9SWH7fMlLN2MBGUsFZ_wHaccPaEcEaotgV2LeLdbfRcGilpTuyuIARtYs4KR3vmO-0A-FB75yOpL4YxptjIwKc_YtUFpGO-23cEBfwqxRK1kd3wSgbQ3DU1Dh_X1Y6Ol3miZX9X4XjeskaeQoPvAv3Lj1_Zt6BoRPHoaAKJAjqnNFrfwRzaEIMzhMjictLjvNCa6qWHUEERBG5PxKSGilPISznX56R7e1FkLln0YZgqHBZH5Ra)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXyf7hM1DRM6efr9Iqp9ewgQOAxwy-yqmDdrS_XdKXO56-XU1zPwOGFIqIAw0EJrO8seCmuLXUJdLTk8YgN1_Wl1QalBKyK_hoIHsVcOZz1gEaPrlGIvIWIthyRdv4Q2kYEaweTSPysQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES6wEBxCJF10T-JoJAmoxOvYTQUzXU-DF_cYDb8u-VipQfyT1YChFejm3zLunAgqLz_U9EFVS22JqWaebd1mhrDknTPh9sNbniALJIKvhO7GnXQQEctLo9Q82eKtouboyOomEFe5rJCmx1kQv0PruZJY8aQEJDaSRSWvk5-BiCe63cqJ0L7ySJMmNSUeZzkb9Wu25qBhn8IQHHwvDra7mL78fzQjlau47eHac9YygHkYGprEcFVsohIgFY4pYBhl3_m-d9MIoMcOJD-tjgTDo7-ztEBcERYdqiB_PYwiSpU7xHFQsZTev4hF1SOD0o)

For more details on how thiamine relates to alcohol-induced brain changes, see the [NIH](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZYLy5YYNuT7H0gdUTuUa-A3OV-v5B20XhVZtbtvrw-p9W3i30pM1dlKwJ8ZR8Sr6A8fEwGX2K6iMOhWIBSWjNuhlcZXkV1RHTT81b1AVPA3ZLsPxciMNYSzCc4udLR4U_alXgnSUvQ) overview.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZYLy5YYNuT7H0gdUTuUa-A3OV-v5B20XhVZtbtvrw-p9W3i30pM1dlKwJ8ZR8Sr6A8fEwGX2K6iMOhWIBSWjNuhlcZXkV1RHTT81b1AVPA3ZLsPxciMNYSzCc4udLR4U_alXgnSUvQ)Are you asking for **yourself** or **someone else** , and are there any **symptoms** like confusion, balance issues, or vision changes? items.title: Why Alcohol Causes Thiamine Deficiency
items.text: Reduced absorption: Alcohol irritates the digestive tract and interferes with how the gut absorbs thiamine. Poor nutrition: Heavy drinking often replaces balanced meals, lowering dietary thiamine intake. Impaired use and limited storage: The body stores very little thiamine, and heavy alcohol use impairs how cells use and metabolize it.

- **Beriberi:** A deficiency condition that can affect the nervous system and heart.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXPTijOTv7rFVxmw5Vmz12PU1JFPoEqgvjz3-WjqnyRWSH2GBUQsqTOdKL--cN_YoIFhCBLct4XI1JOB_Hx41w5J7tTJ2T_BhXi3OSyxFQ35yzCwKJtYqCrLlG3ySeRmmgOrEy3hMYewz-wbtKb34vWMN53KwQ6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXyf7hM1DRM6efr9Iqp9ewgQOAxwy-yqmDdrS_XdKXO56-XU1zPwOGFIqIAw0EJrO8seCmuLXUJdLTk8YgN1_Wl1QalBKyK_hoIHsVcOZz1gEaPrlGIvIWIthyRdv4Q2kYEaweTSPysQ)

items.title: How Thiamine Is Used
items.text: Prevention and withdrawal: Doctors often prescribe oral thiamine for people with alcohol dependence or poor nutrition, and may give higher doses or intravenous (IV) / intramuscular (IM) thiamine during alcohol withdrawal or hospitalization when malabsorption or severe symptoms are a concern. Limits of supplements alone: Continuing heavy alcohol use blocks absorption and reduces how well supplements work. Medical evaluation is important—especially if confusion, balance trouble, or vision changes occur—and alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous without medical supervision.
